messages.subject: Project Zephyr — completion logistics for the 28th
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Ahead of signing tomorrow: we'll exchange executed PDF counterparts under clause 14.5, originals to follow by post. Both boards have approved (Penrose 26 Nov, Wexbourne 27 Nov). The execution version reflects the agreed commercials — £4.5m upfront, £950k annual, 4.5% royalty capped at £2.0m, £9m liability cap, three-year exclusivity, seven-year term.

Please send me the signatory name and title for Wexbourne so I can finalise the signature pages.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0531

messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Delighted to confirm the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement has now been executed by both parties and exchange has completed. The executed PDF is attached for your records.

Key diary items: Upfront Fee (£4.5m) payable within 30 days; first Annual Licence Fee on the first anniversary; M1 (Daventry pilot acceptance) targeted for 31 January 2026. Congratulations to everyone — a great result on Penrose's first major out-licence.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
